attributes.name: Vendor Name
attributes.description: Name of the supplier/vendor listed on the invoice

attributes.name: Invoice Number
attributes.description: The unique invoice number assigned to the invoice

attributes.name: Invoice Date
attributes.description: The date shown on the invoice

attributes.name: PO Number
attributes.description: The purchase order number shown on the invoice

attributes.name: Due Date
attributes.description: The payment due date stated on the invoice

attributes.name: Currency
attributes.description: The currency used for the invoice amounts

attributes.name: Subtotal
attributes.description: The invoice subtotal before tax or VAT is added

attributes.name: Tax
attributes.description: The total tax or VAT amount charged on the invoice

attributes.name: Total Amount
attributes.description: The final amount due on the invoice, including tax or VAT

attributes.name: Payment Details
attributes.description: Bank account or payment information provided on the invoice
